diagnostics.message: The Lambda permission :resource.aws_lambda_permission.cur_per_service uses a literal function name, so Terraform does not ensure module :module.cur_per_service has created the function before the permission is added. Reference the module's function ARN/name to establish this dependency.

The Lambda permission :resource.aws_lambda_permission.cur_per_resource uses a literal function name, so Terraform does not ensure module :module.cur_per_resource has created the function before the permission is added. Reference the module's function ARN/name to establish this dependency.

The Lambda permission :resource.aws_lambda_permission.cur_per_resource_process uses a literal function name, so Terraform does not ensure module :module.cur_per_resource_process has created the function before the permission is added. Reference the module's function ARN/name to establish this dependency.

The S3 notification :resource.aws_s3_bucket_notification.cur_notification configures the :module.cur_per_resource_process Lambda target but does not wait for its S3 invoke permission :resource.aws_lambda_permission.cur_per_resource_process. S3 notification setup must follow creation of the corresponding Lambda permission.

The export :resource.aws_bcmdataexports_export.cur_per_resource writes to the billing bucket, but it can be created before :resource.aws_s3_bucket_policy.cur_bucket_policy grants the BCM Data Exports service access required for delivery. Add an explicit dependency on the bucket policy.

The export :resource.aws_bcmdataexports_export.cur_per_service writes to the billing bucket, but it can be created before :resource.aws_s3_bucket_policy.cur_bucket_policy grants the BCM Data Exports service access required for delivery. Add an explicit dependency on the bucket policy.
